## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what this changes and why. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] Relevant native build/check completed, or the reason it could not run is documented.
- [ ] Affected behavior was checked in the desktop app when applicable; include OS and capture/audio configuration.
- [ ] Documentation and platform claims match the implemented behavior.

For UI changes, attach a screenshot or short recording with private information removed. For documentation-only changes, mark native/manual app checks as not applicable.
